pub surgeist_paint::ZeroHeightGradientColorsOutcome::result: core::result::Result<surgeist_paint::ZeroHeightGradientColors<'a, C>, surgeist_paint::PaintError>
pub fn surgeist_paint::plan_paint_order(request: surgeist_paint::PaintRequest<'_>, options: surgeist_paint::PaintOptions) -> surgeist_paint::PaintOrderOutcome<'_>
pub fn surgeist_paint::plan_stacking(boxes: &[surgeist_paint::BoxFacts], root_box: surgeist_paint::BoxId, options: surgeist_paint::PaintOptions) -> surgeist_paint::PaintOutcome<'_>
pub fn surgeist_paint::resolve_border_image(request: surgeist_paint::BorderImageRequest, options: surgeist_paint::PaintOptions) -> surgeist_paint::BorderImageOutcome
pub fn surgeist_paint::resolve_gradient_stops<'a, C>(line_length: f64, source: &'a [surgeist_paint::GradientStopItem<C>], options: surgeist_paint::PaintOptions) -> surgeist_paint::GradientStopsOutcome<'a, C>
pub fn surgeist_paint::resolve_linear_gradient(size: surgeist_layout::geometry::Size<f64>, direction: surgeist_paint::LinearGradientDirection, options: surgeist_paint::PaintOptions) -> surgeist_paint::LinearGradientOutcome
pub fn surgeist_paint::resolve_radial_gradient(box_size: surgeist_layout::geometry::Size<f64>, center: core::option::Option<surgeist_layout::geometry::Point<f64>>, ending_size: surgeist_paint::RadialGradientSize, options: surgeist_paint::PaintOptions) -> surgeist_paint::RadialGradientOutcome
pub fn surgeist_paint::resolve_zero_height_gradient_colors<'a, C>(geometry: &surgeist_paint::RadialGradientGeometry, source: &'a [surgeist_paint::GradientStopItem<C>], repeat: surgeist_paint::GradientRepeat, options: surgeist_paint::PaintOptions) -> surgeist_paint::ZeroHeightGradientColorsOutcome<'a, C>
